description: A photograph depicts a landscape identified as dry Mediterranean grasslands in the Extremadura region, South Western Spain. In the immediate foreground, there is dry, sparse, yellowish vegetation, and a two-strand wire fence stretches horizontally across the lower third of the image. Behind the fence, a field of lush green grassland contains several dark, indistinct specks, possibly grazing animals. A line of green deciduous trees runs across the midground, with a drier, lighter-coloured hill visible directly behind them. In the far background, faint hills or mountains meet a clear blue sky with some wispy clouds. A prominent leafless tree with numerous bare branches occupies the right side of the foreground, partially framing the scene. Credit: M. Palacios.
